sn11.22:2.2: ‘Here, sir, an ugly and deformed spirit is sitting on the throne of Sakka, the lord of gods.
sn11.22:2.3: But the gods of the thirty-three complained, grumbled, and objected, sir:
sn11.22:2.5: This ugly and deformed spirit is sitting on the throne of Sakka, the lord of gods.”
sn11.22:2.6: But the more, sir, the gods complained, the more attractive, good-looking, and lovely that spirit became.
